001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.util.Arrays;
008
009/**
010 * Written when the pump answers a remote cartridge-change or fill command. Seen on the Tandem Mobi.
011 *
012 * <p>Tandem's export and its Mobi app do not name this opcode, so the class name is provisional.
013 * Byte 10 is the opcode of the response the pump sent and byte 12 its status. The five values seen
014 * are the CONTROL-characteristic responses {@code EnterChangeCartridgeModeResponse} (145),
015 * {@code ExitChangeCartridgeModeResponse} (147), {@code EnterFillTubingModeResponse} (149),
016 * {@code ExitFillTubingModeResponse} (151) and {@code FillCannulaResponse} (153). They look like
017 * wizard step codes only because a site change sends those commands in that order.
018 *
019 * <p>Each record is written immediately after the history record of the matching request (opcode
020 * 290), whose request opcode is this response opcode minus 1: 192/194 records across TandemKit logs
021 * and BLE captures, the 2 exceptions sitting at a capture gap. In the maintainer's TandemKit logs
022 * the count equals the number of these requests sent (31 = 4 + 4 + 9 + 9 + 5).
023 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/148.
024 */
025@HistoryLogProps(
026    opCode = 359,
027    displayName = "Cartridge/Fill Response",
028    internalName = ""
029)
030public class CartridgeFillResponseHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
031
032    private int responseOpCode;
033    private int unknown11;
034    private int status;
035    private byte[] unknownTail;
036
037    public CartridgeFillResponseHistoryLog() {}
038    public CartridgeFillResponseHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int responseOpCode, int unknown11, int status, byte[] unknownTail) {
039        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
040        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, responseOpCode, unknown11, status, unknownTail);
041        this.responseOpCode = responseOpCode;
042        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
043        this.status = status;
044        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOf(unknownTail, 13);
045    }
046
047    public CartridgeFillResponseHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int responseOpCode, int status) {
048        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, responseOpCode, 0, status, new byte[13]);
049    }
050
051    public int typeId() {
052        return 359;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * <table border="1">
057     * <caption>Parsed fields for CartridgeFillResponseHistoryLog:</caption>
058     * <tr><td><code>responseOpCode</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>status</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>unknownTail</code></td><td><code>Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 13, 26)</code></td></tr>
062     * </table>
063     */
064    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
065        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
066        this.cargo = raw;
067        parseBase(raw);
068        this.responseOpCode = raw[10] & 0xFF;
069        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
070        this.status = raw[12] & 0xFF;
071        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 13, 26);
072    }
073
074    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int responseOpCode, int unknown11, int status, byte[] unknownTail) {
075        Validate.isTrue(unknownTail.length == 13, "unknownTail must be 13 bytes");
076        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
077            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(359, 0),
078            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
079            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
080            new byte[]{ (byte) responseOpCode, (byte) unknown11, (byte) status },
081            unknownTail));
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * The unsigned opcode of the CONTROL-characteristic response the pump sent (pumpX2's signed
086     * {@code opCode & 0xFF}): 145, 147, 149, 151 or 153 in every observed record.
087     */
088    public int getResponseOpCode() {
089        return responseOpCode;
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * The response's status byte: 0 for success.
094     *
095     * <p>In one maintainer capture the app sent ExitChangeCartridgeMode twice; the pump answered
096     * status 0 then status 1, and this record reads 1 in the same second as the failed response.
097     * Every response of these types in the TandemKit logs (34) had status 0, as did the matching
098     * records.
099     */
100    public int getStatus() {
101        return status;
102    }
103
104    /**
105     * Byte 11, zero in every observed record (194/194).
106     */
107    public int getUnknown11() {
108        return unknown11;
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * Bytes 13-25, all zero in every observed record (194/194).
113     */
114    public byte[] getUnknownTail() {
115        return unknownTail;
116    }
117}
